text:
deploy-bot: Canary rc-2026-09-03-a deployed to canary-usw2. Post-deploy smoke (prefill-lite) started 150 samples. Noting p95 drift ~+160ms and synth heartbeat dip 0.8%. tagging #eng-releases :triage_lights:

marta: seeing alerts, pulling traces. which pack is this?

kevin: this is pack-int8-13b. quick trace sample shows occasional split tokens at end-of-line causing extra decode hops.

qa-hugo: repro command: `seq 1 200 | xargs -n1 -P5 -I{} curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/smoke -d '{"prompt":"ok"}'`  bursts of p95.

sre-olga: kernel fallback looks correlated. options: rollback canary, divert synth, or pin user routes. prefer divert synth first to keep telemetry on canary.

marta: agree. prepare route synth-reroute-0903 -> float16-13b and increase tracing for synth to 100% for 5m.

deploy-bot: Applied route synth-reroute-0903 -> float16-13b. Tracing sampling set to 100% for tag canary-synth. Verification window started.

qa-hugo: after reroute, synth p95 returned to baseline. sampled traces no longer show split EOL tokens. :white_check_mark:

kevin: filing INF-2026-777. summary: int8 tokenizer splitting EOL into extra tokens causing fallback kernel thrash and p95 spikes. assigning to kevin.

sre-olga: decision: keep synth rerouted for 24h, pause user ramp, pin user route if we see user p95 regressions. Open ticket and plan a hotfix in next change window.

marta: ticket created, reroute and pause noted in release draft. will monitor telemetry and reconvene after 24h. :thumbsup:
